# scikit-learn

> scikit-learn is a Python machine learning library providing tools for data generation, model building, and evaluation across supervised and unsupervised learning tasks.

scikit-learn offers comprehensive APIs for dataset generation, model training, and utilities for handling metadata and estimator properties. The library focuses on practical machine learning workflows with synthetic and real-world datasets.

## Key Topics

- scikit-learn
- Dataset Generation
- Gaussian Blobs
- Synthetic Data
- API Reference
- Regression
- Clustering
- Estimator Tags
- Metadata Routing
- Python
- RandomState
- Transformer Utilities

- Sample Generators
- Data Loading

## Dataset Generation

- [make_blobs](https://sklearn.org/stable/modules/generated/sklearn.datasets.make_blobs.html): Generate Gaussian blob datasets for clustering and synthetic data creation
- [fetch_species_distributions](https://sklearn.org/stable/modules/generated/sklearn.datasets.fetch_species_distributions.html): Fetch ecological species distribution dataset for real-world machine learning tasks

## Estimator Utilities & Metadata

- [MetadataRouter](https://sklearn.org/stable/modules/generated/sklearn.utils.metadata_routing.MetadataRouter.html): Route metadata through machine learning pipelines for proper parameter handling
- [RegressorTags](https://sklearn.org/stable/modules/generated/sklearn.utils.RegressorTags.html): Access and manage metadata tags for regressor estimators
- [TransformerTags](https://sklearn.org/stable/modules/generated/sklearn.utils.TransformerTags.html): Access and manage metadata tags for transformer estimators

## Data Loading & Samples

- [load_sample_image](https://sklearn.org/stable/modules/generated/sklearn.datasets.load_sample_image.html): Load sample images for computer vision and image processing demonstrations
